name: figma-workspace
description: Figma Workspace MCP frontend with local Figma MCP login support.

interface.shortDescription: Use Figma MCP through a stateful workspace proxy with local Figma MCP login.
interface.longDescription: Provides the persistent figma_workspace_mcp MCP server for the official Figma remote MCP endpoint, plus a local HTTP bridge used for Figma MCP login and credential caching. The transparent @jxx-codex-plugins/figma-workspace-stdio package remains available through the optional figma_workspace_upstream_stdio CLI and Node library surface for debugging.
